_note: The Company Store (Cosmetics.cs, CompanyStoreScreen): what banked Resources buy. Looks only: nothing here changes how anything fights. A slot wears one item at a time, and wearing nothing is the standard issue. paint: hull_dark and hull_light are BIT's plating from shadow to highlight, glow its eyes, painted panels, shots and outline; its frames wear the same. trim: rim is the edge light on every tower. spire: rim is the Spire's edge light, crown a Data/Towers sheet set on its top, fitted a little wider than the Spire's column (Cosmetics.CrownScaleFor) times crown_scale. price is in banked Resources. requires_campaigns: campaigns that must be finished on the save before it can be bought. No red or magenta glows: those are the enemies' colours.

slots.name: BIT's paint
slots.what: BIT's plating and glow, on foot and in the Strider and the Titan.

slots.name: Tower trim
slots.what: The edge light every tower wears.

slots.name: Spire lights
slots.what: The Spire's edge light, and a crown over its top.

items.name: Ember
items.line: Black plating, furnace glow. Legal asks that you not call it a warning colour.

items.name: Verdigris
items.line: Old copper gone green. Looks like it has been deployed 800 times. It has.

items.name: Bone
items.line: White plating. Shows every scratch. AXIS considers that a feature.

items.name: Royal
items.line: Deep violet with gold lights. Not approved for assets. Approved for purchase.

items.name: Reactor
items.line: Gunmetal with a reactor-green core. The glow is cosmetic. Mostly.

items.name: Gold Leaf
items.line: For assets that finished a campaign and were redeployed anyway.

items.name: Void
items.line: Plating that reflects nothing, lit from inside. Two campaigns. You have earned being hard to look at.

items.name: Ice
items.line: Cold white edge lights. Reads clean on either planet.

items.name: Signal Green
items.line: Every tower reports ready. None of them are lying.

items.name: Gold
items.line: Costs more than the towers. That is the point.

items.name: Ultraviolet
items.line: Just short of a colour. Just short of regulation.

items.name: White Hot
items.line: The whole field lit like a weld. Issued after a campaign.

items.name: Halo
items.line: A ring of light over the rig. It still falls. It falls well lit.

items.name: Orbit
items.line: Three rings that never touch. Nobody at AXIS knows what they measure.

items.name: Beacon
items.line: Seen from every canyon on the map. So is everything it attracts.

items.name: Crown
items.line: Gold, spiked, unnecessary. For a rig that outlived a campaign.
